full_prompt_en: A square hyperreal creature portrait fills the frame with the head and upper shoulders of a weathered horned being against a featureless black background. The face turns three-quarters to the right, its gaze lowered and stern. Heavy ridges rise above deep-set dark eyes, and a broad wrinkled nose leads to tightly closed, downturned lips. Thick curved horns emerge from the upper temples and run beyond the top crop; a pointed ear projects sharply to the left. The gray-white skin is densely sculpted with fine cracks, pores, creases, and uneven patches that change from pale bone color on the brow to charcoal in the hollows. Coarser fibers grow around the cheek and jaw, then gather into a long white beard whose individual strands remain visible against the dark chest. Near the lower left, a strip of rough woven costume fabric hints at a shoulder without diverting attention from the face. The crop is extremely close: horn, ear, brow, and beard touch or nearly touch the edges, leaving only narrow wedges of black around the silhouette. This tightness amplifies the practical surface detail. The image has a cinematic special-effects realism, as though textured prosthetic makeup and carefully groomed hair have been photographed under studio control. A soft but directional light from the upper left grazes the forehead, nose, cheek ridges, and beard, while the eye sockets, mouth corners, and right side deepen toward black. The cool gray palette is nearly monochrome, with faint earthy brown in horn and cloth. The creature feels tangible and imposing because its impossible anatomy is rendered through convincing material texture, precise edge detail, and restrained shadow.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形超写实生物肖像让一位饱经风霜的长角生命的头部和上肩填满画面，背景是不含细节的纯黑。脸向右呈四分之三角度，目光低垂而严厉。厚重眉骨在深陷眼睛上方隆起，宽而多皱的鼻子通向紧闭、下撇的嘴唇。粗壮弯角从上太阳穴长出，越过顶部裁切；一只尖耳向左锐利伸出。灰白皮肤密布细裂、毛孔、褶纹和不均匀斑块，从眉部的浅骨色转为凹处的炭灰。较粗毛发长在脸颊和下颌周围，聚成一把长白胡须，单根毛丝在深色胸前仍可分辨。左下角一条粗织服装布料暗示肩部，却不把注意力从脸上移开。裁切极近：角、耳、额头与胡须接触或几乎接触边缘，轮廓旁只留细窄黑色楔形空间。紧缩构图放大了实体表面细节。图像具有电影特效的现实感，仿佛纹理精细的假体化妆与梳理过的毛发被受控影棚灯拍下。左上方柔和而定向的光擦过额头、鼻子、脸颊隆脊和胡须，眼窝、嘴角与右侧则加深到黑色。冷灰配色几乎单色，角和布料中隐有土棕。这个生物之所以有实体感和威压，是因为不可能的解剖结构通过可信的材质纹理、精确边缘细节与克制阴影呈现。
style_prompt_en: A hyperreal practical-effects photographic treatment uses an extreme close crop, a nearly featureless black surround, and meticulous tactile surface detail. Cool bone gray and charcoal dominate, with very small earthy brown undertones. Raised ridges catch soft upper-side light while cavities fall into deep, controlled darkness; this grazing illumination reveals pores, cracks, rough fibers, fine striations, and individual pale strands. The central form has dense sculptural modeling rather than painterly simplification, and its irregular contours nearly touch the frame on multiple sides. Matte textured areas contrast with slightly smoother worn highlights, giving every material a different light response. The background remains flat and black, separating the complex silhouette without contextual clutter. Soft-edged light prevents a hard theatrical spotlight, but the high local contrast makes raised details feel sharply physical. The composition is severe, intimate, and cinematic, using close scale and believable handmade texture to give an uncanny form persuasive weight.
style_prompt_zh: 超写实实体特效摄影处理采用极近裁切、几乎无细节的黑色周围空间和精密有触感的表面细节。冷骨灰与炭色占主导，只有极少土棕底色。隆起脊线接住柔和上侧光，凹处落入受控深暗；这种掠射照明揭示毛孔、裂纹、粗纤维、细刻纹和单根浅色丝线。中央形体有密集雕塑式塑形，而非绘画式简化，不规则轮廓在多侧几乎触边。哑光纹理区域对照略平滑的磨亮高点，让不同材质对光各有回应。背景保持平黑，在不加入环境杂物的前提下分出复杂剪影。柔边光避免硬戏剧聚光，但强局部对比让凸起细节具有鲜明实体感。构图严峻、亲密且电影化，以近距离和可信的手工材质为怪异形体赋予令人信服的重量。
theme_en: A weathered horned fantasy creature shown as a practical-effects close portrait
theme_zh: 以实体特效质感拍摄的苍老长角奇幻生物近景
name: Rick Baker
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
